Status moves to Accepted when...' and 'Consequences (if option 1)' and calls option 1 'proposed', although Status is Accepted; (b) it does not record the accepted delete race (owner ruling 8, waiver 0f290e25) or the update save ordering (link/replace before fields, unlink after). Those two live only in PG-205-findings.md and codex-review-waivers.yaml
findings.recommendation: Add one 'Accepted risk' and one 'Update save ordering' bullet to ADR-080 and drop the stale proposed/if-option-1 wording. Docs only, not a gate failure

findings.issue: Update ordering verified in code: link/replace (single save via ContactService.replaceAccount) runs before applyContactInfoUpdates, unlink runs after. Fields and account are still two saves, so a failure between them can leave the account changed and the fields unchanged; this is documented and was judged out of scope

Accepted risk (owner ruling 8): contactTypes.delete has no FK from contacts, so a concurrently saved contact can keep a deleted key. Mitigations verified: create never re-issues a key contacts still carry, update skips type rules for a key with no type row, waivers are recorded
findings.recommendation: None; revisit if ContactService gains a transactional save path
